fixtures.description: The submit button's id attribute churns between deploys; data-testid, name, type, accessible name, structure, and text all stay the same.
The checkout button gains two new wrapping div layers (a sticky-footer redesign) while every attribute and the visible text stay identical.
Button copy changes from Add to Cart to Add to Bag; id, data-testid, and structure stay identical.

A second cart row with an identical Remove button (no distinguishing attributes) appears alongside the original; nothing in the candidate set can disambiguate them, so Tier 2.5 must refuse rather than guess.
The archive control keeps its data-testid but is re-rendered as a link with role=link where the stored evidence recorded role=button; the attribute match alone must not be enough to accept.

The P14-23 round 2 false-heal vector: narrowing the conflicting-stable-identity gate (an exact data-testid match now outweighs a differing id) means a second, genuinely different row with the same duplicated data-testid must still never be accepted over the real target.

The realistic shape of the P14-23 round 3 false-heal vector, not the degenerate exact-tie: the ground-truth row's own copy and structure genuinely drift (wrapped, reworded) while an unrelated duplicate row keeps the SAME data-testid and still matches the OLD evidence byte-for-byte — so the decoy would outscore the real element outright without the structural ambiguity gate. Must refuse, never accept the higher-scoring decoy.

The P14-23 round 4 false-heal vector: an email field identified only by name/type (no id, no data-testid, no data-test anywhere) whose own evidence has genuinely drifted (reworded aria-label, wrapped, repositioned), while an unrelated duplicate field still matches the OLD stale evidence byte-for-byte. Without a stable key, nothing in the stored snapshot can distinguish 'the real field drifted' from 'a different field still matches the old snapshot' — must refuse.
The dismissible promo banner (and its close button) is removed from the page entirely; no interactive elements remain for collection to find.
